recognize_zh: 視野中幾乎沒有正常大小的血小板，只見中央一顆大型、深染顆粒狀的血小板（接近小紅血球大小），紅血球形態大致正常、無破碎紅血球或異常白血球，符合免疫性血小板低下（ITP）的血小板減少合併大型血小板。
features: Marked paucity of platelets in the field
Single large, darkly staining granular platelet at center, approaching the size of a small RBC
Red cells normocytic with central pallor; occasional overlapping and one elongated cell but no schistocytes
No leukocyte abnormalities or circulating blasts in view
Warm color cast and limited resolution of the photograph
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows markedly decreased platelets, with a single large, darkly granular platelet in the center of the field. Red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes, spherocytosis or significant poikilocytosis, and no abnormal leukocytes are present in this field. Isolated thrombocytopenia with large platelets and otherwise unremarkable morphology reflects increased peripheral destruction with compensatory young platelet release. Findings are consistent with immune thrombocytopenia in the appropriate clinical context, which remains a diagnosis of exclusion.

ddx.vs: Pseudothrombocytopenia shows platelet clumps or satellitism on the smear, especially at the feathered edge, which are absent here.
Inherited forms show uniformly giant platelets from birth with abnormal aggregation studies or Dohle-like neutrophil inclusions, requiring family history and platelet function or genetic testing.
TTP shows schistocytes and polychromasia with hemolysis, which are not seen in this field.
Marrow disorders show small platelets or additional cytopenias, macrocytosis, dysplasia, blasts or leukoerythroblastosis.
